title: Check yourself: What Claude does well, and where it slips

questions.stem: A finance team pastes forty invoice amounts into a prompt and asks Claude for the sum. The reply reads fluently and is off by a few cents. What is the most dependable correction?

options.text: Let it call a code tool and pass on the tool's result
options.says: Exact arithmetic is a task for a tool, because the model works on tokens (the maths and counting section), and the first trap says to move such work into code.

options.text: Add a closing line asking Claude to flag how sure it is of the total
options.says: Ruled out because reasoning "needs a check that does not come from the same reasoning", and the model's own report of certainty is not one.

options.text: Reformat the amounts into one column so the sum is easier to follow
options.says: Ruled out because exact arithmetic on long numbers is "approximate unless the model does the work in a tool", however the amounts are laid out.

options.text: Ask for the sum again with an instruction to double-check each step
options.says: Ruled out because a re-check request "does not change that the model sees pieces", and the section says the fix is not a better prompt.

questions.stem: An inspection app sends shelf photographs and asks Claude how many bottles are visible. Totals are sometimes wrong on crowded shelves, and the total feeds a purchasing decision. Which design response fits what the documentation says?

options.text: Shrink each photo heavily so the scene looks simpler to the model
options.says: Ruled out because Claude "might hallucinate or make mistakes when interpreting low-quality, rotated, or very small images under 200 pixels", so heavy shrinking makes it worse.

options.text: Take the coordinates it returns for each bottle as exact positions to count
options.says: Ruled out because the vision list says "Coordinates and localisation outputs are approximate", so they cannot give an exact count either.

options.text: Label the figures approximate and verify the important ones against real stock
options.says: The vision page says counts can be approximate, and its closing advice is to verify interpretations in high-stakes cases, so the figures are labelled as estimates and the ones that matter are checked.

options.text: Switch to a larger model and treat its counts as final in the weekly purchasing report
options.says: Ruled out because the page says "Do not use Claude for tasks requiring perfect precision or sensitive image analysis without human oversight", for any tier.
